seo.title: Security Checklist for Web3 Frontend Developers
seo.description: A comprehensive checklist covering wallet integration, transaction security, and dApp security best practices for Web3 frontend development.

content.intro: Frontend security in Web3 protects users from phishing, transaction manipulation, and data theft. Use this checklist to secure your dApp.

items.text: Never request more permissions than needed from wallets
items.title: Never request more permissions than needed from wallets

items.text: Handle wallet disconnection gracefully without crashes
items.title: Handle wallet disconnection gracefully without crashes

items.text: Validate wallet address format before using
items.title: Validate wallet address format before using

items.text: Support multiple wallets, not just MetaMask
items.title: Support multiple wallets, not just MetaMask

items.text: Detect and handle network/chain switching
items.title: Detect and handle network/chain switching

items.text: Show clear UI states for connecting, connected, and disconnected
items.title: Show clear UI states for connecting, connected, and disconnected

items.text: Persist connection state appropriately (don't reconnect without consent)
items.title: Persist connection state appropriately (don't reconnect without consent)

items.text: Handle wallet extension conflicts gracefully
items.title: Handle wallet extension conflicts gracefully

items.text: Always simulate transactions before sending to catch errors
items.title: Always simulate transactions before sending to catch errors

items.text: Show clear transaction details before user signs
items.title: Show clear transaction details before user signs

items.text: Display gas estimates in both native token and USD
items.title: Display gas estimates in both native token and USD

items.text: Implement transaction status tracking (pending/confirmed/failed)
items.title: Implement transaction status tracking (pending/confirmed/failed)

items.text: Handle transaction reverts with user-friendly error messages
items.title: Handle transaction reverts with user-friendly error messages

items.text: Validate all user inputs before including in transactions
items.title: Validate all user inputs before including in transactions

items.text: Check token allowances before attempting transfers
items.title: Check token allowances before attempting transfers

items.text: Warn users about unlimited token approvals
items.title: Warn users about unlimited token approvals

items.text: Implement transaction timeout handling
items.title: Implement transaction timeout handling

items.text: Provide speedup/cancel options for stuck transactions
items.title: Provide speedup/cancel options for stuck transactions

items.text: Use typed data signing (EIP-712) instead of raw message signing
items.title: Use typed data signing (EIP-712) instead of raw message signing

items.text: Display human-readable message content before signing
items.title: Display human-readable message content before signing

items.text: Include domain separator in typed data to prevent replay attacks
items.title: Include domain separator in typed data to prevent replay attacks

items.text: Add nonces to signatures to prevent reuse
items.title: Add nonces to signatures to prevent reuse

items.text: Include expiry timestamps in time-sensitive signatures
items.title: Include expiry timestamps in time-sensitive signatures

items.text: Never sign messages containing raw transaction data
items.title: Never sign messages containing raw transaction data

items.text: Validate signature requests come from your own frontend
items.title: Validate signature requests come from your own frontend

items.text: Sanitize all URL parameters before use
items.title: Sanitize all URL parameters before use

items.text: Validate address inputs match expected format (checksummed)
items.title: Validate address inputs match expected format (checksummed)

items.text: Validate amount inputs are positive numbers
items.title: Validate amount inputs are positive numbers

items.text: Check for integer overflow in amount calculations
items.title: Check for integer overflow in amount calculations

items.text: Validate token decimals match expected values
items.title: Validate token decimals match expected values

items.text: Sanitize ENS names before resolution
items.title: Sanitize ENS names before resolution

items.text: Validate contract addresses exist and have code
items.title: Validate contract addresses exist and have code

items.text: Escape special characters in user-provided data
items.title: Escape special characters in user-provided data

items.text: Never store private keys in frontend code or storage
items.title: Never store private keys in frontend code or storage

items.text: Do not store sensitive data in localStorage
items.title: Do not store sensitive data in localStorage

items.text: Clear sensitive data from memory after use
items.title: Clear sensitive data from memory after use

items.text: Use HTTPS for all API calls
items.title: Use HTTPS for all API calls

items.text: Validate SSL certificates for RPC endpoints
items.title: Validate SSL certificates for RPC endpoints

items.text: Do not log sensitive transaction data
items.title: Do not log sensitive transaction data

items.text: Implement proper error handling to avoid leaking stack traces
items.title: Implement proper error handling to avoid leaking stack traces

items.text: Verify contract addresses against known good addresses
items.title: Verify contract addresses against known good addresses

items.text: Display clear warnings for unknown contracts
items.title: Display clear warnings for unknown contracts

items.text: Show full destination addresses, not just truncated versions, for large transactions
items.title: Show full destination addresses, not just truncated versions, for large transactions

items.text: Implement address book for frequent recipients
items.title: Implement address book for frequent recipients

items.text: Warn about address poisoning attacks
items.title: Warn about address poisoning attacks

items.text: Display ENS verification alongside addresses
items.title: Display ENS verification alongside addresses

items.text: Check token contracts against known scam lists
items.title: Check token contracts against known scam lists

items.text: Implement error boundaries to prevent full app crashes
items.title: Implement error boundaries to prevent full app crashes

items.text: Handle RPC errors gracefully with retry logic
items.title: Handle RPC errors gracefully with retry logic

items.text: Display user-friendly error messages, not raw errors
items.title: Display user-friendly error messages, not raw errors

items.title: Log errors for debugging without exposing sensitive data

items.text: Handle network timeouts with appropriate fallbacks
items.title: Handle network timeouts with appropriate fallbacks

items.text: Implement circuit breakers for failing services
items.title: Implement circuit breakers for failing services

items.title: Audit npm packages for known vulnerabilities (npm audit)

items.title: Lock dependency versions to prevent supply chain attacks

items.text: Use integrity hashes for CDN resources
items.title: Use integrity hashes for CDN resources

items.title: Review dependency code for wallet or key handling

items.title: Implement Content Security Policy headers

items.title: Avoid using eval() or innerHTML with user data

items.title: Minify and obfuscate production builds

items.title: Test with slow network conditions

proTips: Test wallet flows on actual mobile devices, not just responsive browser views.
Use transaction simulation (Tenderly, Blowfish) before every on-chain action.
Cache RPC responses aggressively. Users notice slow dApps.
